title: Behavioral data made simple by Fullstory

hook.text: Access to customer behavioral data is transforming today's digital experiences.

cta.text: Schedule a demo today to learn more.

summary.tone: Warm, optimistic and playful: a relatable two-shopper story (Alex converts, Sam gives up) told with live-action cut-outs, recreated storefront UI and a confetti-like four-colour dot motif, resolving into confident benefit-led product claims.

signature_moments.description: Live-action shoppers sit beneath a large recreated store UI; a blurred glow halo behind each person shifts to a success tone when Alex checks out and to an alarm tone when Sam hits the availability error.
signature_moments.why_premium: Turns an abstract metric (conversion vs abandonment) into an emotional, instantly readable cue that carries the story without any added text, and the mixed-media compositing looks bespoke rather than templated.

signature_moments.description: Under 'Manual Tagging' only the bold verbs are legible while the rest is blurred; the header rolls to 'True Behavior', the text sharpens and colour highlights sweep the sentences, then dissolve into the falling dots that become the video's visual language.
signature_moments.why_premium: Demonstrates the product's core differentiator (seeing everything between the clicks) as a single visual metaphor, and the hand-off from highlights to particles ties the whole film's motion system together.

signature_moments.description: Captured sessions zoom into a full-frame dot field that sorts itself into labelled sentiment bands (Delight, Engagement, Trepidation, Rage), and the orange stream then flows node by node through a journey map, resolving skeleton cards into a 'Dead Click Add to Cart' insight.
signature_moments.why_premium: Continuous particle choreography across shots (no hard cuts) makes data processing feel physical and intelligent, a level of custom simulation work most SaaS explainers do not attempt.

hook.evidence: Opens on a broad category claim (w0-w9) with a doodled kinetic headline; well crafted but generic, and the real tension (two shoppers, different outcomes) only arrives at s002-s005 and the question at w58-w65.

clarity.evidence: Clear problem-to-solution arc built on one concrete story (Alex vs Sam) that returns as payoff (w290-w292, s017); the middle outcome stretch (s014) compresses many abstract benefits into a fast list and is harder to follow.

ui_showcase.evidence: Product is shown as simplified recreations (replay player, live event log, sentiment bands, journey map, metric cards, Slack hand-off) that map each feature to the story; real product UI is never shown in detail and in-UI labels are small.

motion_polish.evidence: Consistent motion system: zoom-through transitions, 3D tilts of a glass frame, blur-to-sharp reveals and a four-colour dot swarm that links nearly every shot; at 2 fps easing cannot be verified, and a few transitions are long continuous transforms rather than crisp cuts.

sound_design.evidence: Judged from anchors plus visuals: a music bed at about 112 BPM with dense detected SFX (130 candidates in 135.7 s, mostly swoosh_reverse/impact/unsure) that cluster around transitions and particle moments; integrated loudness is quiet at -22.4 LUFS. Competent support, but many detections are low-confidence and none stands out as a signature sound.

vo_script_quality.evidence: Story-led script with a named-character question (w58-w65) and a callback payoff (w290-w301); clear pain framing (w88-w97). Weaker spots: jargon-dense benefit lists (w257-w273) and generic proof without names (w124-w131).

brand_consistency.evidence: The same four-colour dot motif, vivid gradient backgrounds, glass-framed player, geometric sans and fullstory wordmark recur from s006 to the end card, and the confetti burst in s018 reuses the dot palette to land on the logo.

works_muted.evidence: The Alex/Sam conversion story, outcome headlines and end card read without sound (s005, s013, s017, s018), but there are no captions and the mechanism (dot field, sentiment bands, journey map) relies on VO to explain what is happening.

overall.evidence: A polished mixed-media explainer with a strong unifying particle language and a relatable story arc that pays off; held back from best-in-class by a generic opening claim, a dense benefit-list middle section and limited real product UI.

localization_friendliness.notes: Much English text is baked into kinetic headlines (s001, s006, s013), caption pills (s014) and dense recreated UI (storefront, event log, journey cards, metrics, end card), and the story's mechanism relies on the VO; localising would need re-rendering most scenes plus a new voice track, though the live-action and particle scenes are language-neutral.

annotation.focal_element: Three-line headline statement with hand-drawn doodle accents (burst marks top-left, looping arrow under 'experiences')
annotation.transition_other: opening shot; no incoming transition (anchors give null)
on_screen_text: Behavioral data is transforming today's digital experiences.
annotation.typography: Large left-aligned three-line sentence-case statement in a geometric sans; 'Behavioral data' set in extra-bold with a quirky stylised 'r'/'a' display cut, remaining words in regular weight; normal tracking, generous leading. Lines appear to resolve from faded to full opacity at the start. Font guess (low confidence): a custom brand grotesk.
annotation.what_happens: On a soft gradient background the headline is already present and resolves from partially faded to full contrast by 0.5 s; from about 1.0 s a hand-drawn burst draws on beside 'Behavioral' and a looping squiggle arrow draws on under 'experiences', then the frame holds while the VO (w0-w9) says the line, which differs slightly from the on-screen copy ('Access to customer behavioral data is...').
annotation.build_rebuild: Render a centred three-line text block with the first two words in an extra-bold weight, fade lines in over 0.4 s, then animate two SVG doodle paths (burst strokes and a looping arrow) with stroke-dashoffset draw-on over about 0.8 s and hold.

annotation.focal_element: One large browser window with the 'Athena 1' product page, with a single shopper seated beneath and a coloured glow halo behind them that signals success or frustration
annotation.transition_other: split-screen collapses into a single centred panel focused on one shopper (layout reframe)
on_screen_text: Your go-to for comfort and easy styling. Rock this classic sneaker for any occasion.
annotation.typography: Store logo as a two-weight all-caps wordmark (bold 'TREAD' plus light 'WAVE'); product title in bold all-caps condensed sans with bold price right-aligned; body copy in small light mixed-case sans; buttons in small bold sans inside pill shapes; accordion rows in all-caps condensed sans; confirmation headline in bold all-caps. The red error label, cart totals and search results are small on the sheets and read with medium confidence.
annotation.what_happens: The split collapses to the woman (Alex, named by the 'Thank you, Alex!' page) under a large product page: she opens the size dropdown, picks a size, clicks Add to Cart (button shows a loading state then 'Added'), opens the cart and checks out to a thank-you page while a soft success-toned glow blooms behind her. A fast horizontal slide with motion blur at about 20.5 s switches to the man (Sam) on the same page: he picks a size, clicks Add to Cart, gets an 'Unable to confirm availability' error, the glow behind him turns an alarm tone, he opens a new tab, searches Google for 'athena 1 sneakers', returns, then throws up his hands and the page spins on a loader. VO covers w30-w65 ('Despite all their similarities ... What made Alex convert and Sam lose interest?').
annotation.build_rebuild: Build one browser-mockup component with scripted states (product page, size dropdown, button loading/added, cart, confirmation, error pill, search page, spinner) driven by a cursor timeline, place a cut-out presenter video beneath it, and animate a blurred radial-gradient glow behind the presenter whose opacity and hue tween between a success and an error colour token on each outcome.

annotation.focal_element: A simplified document-style app card whose header flips from 'Manual Tagging' to 'True Behavior', then the kinetic headline 'Behavioral data' / 'What is happening' / 'Why it's happening', ending on the fullstory wordmark
on_screen_text: Sam enters on homepage as a “direct visitor.” He scrolls down to the "Collections" section and clicks on "White Classics."
He scrolls through the page, hovering over "Pacific" and "VaporX," then pauses over the price for "the "Athena 1." He clicks in “Athena One.”

On the “Athena 1” page, Sam clicks on the size selector and chooses a Size 9 shoe. A network traffic error from the Inventory API causes the page loader to spin indefinitely. Sam highlights the Athena 1 product name and price, then he exits the page.
annotation.typography: Card body in a geometric sans, regular weight sentence case with verbs set in bold (enters, scrolls, clicks, hovering, pauses, network traffic error, spin, highlights, exits); small bold sentence-case card header. Kinetic headlines are large geometric sans: 'Behavioral data' bold with a hand-drawn underline stroke under 'Behavioral'; 'What'/'Why' in heavy black weight in the accent colour beside regular-weight 'is happening'/'it's happening', normal tracking. Lowercase wordmark. Font guess (low confidence): a Gilroy/Sora-like geometric sans.
annotation.what_happens: The card swings in from a slight 3D tilt and settles flat (29.5-30 s). Under 'Manual Tagging' only the bolded verbs type in while the rest of each sentence stays blurred, illustrating that tagged tools see only part of the picture (w66-w87). At about 38.5 s the header rolls from 'Manual Tagging' to 'True Behavior', the blurred text sharpens, and highlight bars sweep across the sentences in three colours (green, purple, pink) in sync with 'Scrolls, text highlights... console logs and network traffic' (w98-w109). The highlights then dissolve into a burst of coloured dots that fall and scatter around a kinetic 'Behavioral data' title with a scribbled underline (w110-w111). A cursor rewrites the headline 'What is happening' into 'Why it's happening' with a small 'Rage click!' label (w116-w123), the text blurs out, grey blurred bokeh dots drift across a faint fullstory wordmark that fills with a multicolour gradient as the dots resolve into it (w124-w133), and the final frame flips to a white logo on a vivid gradient background. Shot spans 29.3-59.0 s and contains three visual phases; anchors list 5 events.
annotation.build_rebuild: Render a white card with a sage header bar; type in only the bold verb spans while the rest of each paragraph sits at blur(4px), then on cue swap the header text with a vertical roll, animate blur to 0 and sweep coloured highlight rects left-to-right across each sentence (staggered ~0.4 s), then convert the highlights into falling particle dots behind a centred 'Behavioral data' title with an SVG underline drawn via stroke-dashoffset, and end with dots converging onto a gradient-filled wordmark.

annotation.focal_element: A session-replay player frame showing the fictional 'TREADWAVE' sneaker storefront, floating on a vivid multicolour gradient background

annotation.focal_element: The enlarged replay player with the storefront scrolled to 'SHOP THE COLLECTIONS' and the Sam Garrison event card overlapping its right edge

annotation.focal_element: A recreated session-replay player framing a fictional sneaker store (category grid, then the 'Athena 1' product page), with a floating event-log card on the right that appends each user action as it happens.
annotation.typography: In-UI text only: storefront uses a condensed, uppercase display face for the logo, product name and accordion labels with mixed-case light body copy; the event-log card uses a clean geometric sans, regular weight, sentence case, with values in small grey pill chips. Product-grid captions and the red error pill are too small to read at sheet resolution.
annotation.what_happens: Inside a rounded, glassy replay frame on a vivid gradient backdrop, the store page loads (grid of sneakers), a cluster of coloured dots stands in for the cursor/user as it clicks a product, the page navigates to the Athena 1 detail view, a size dropdown opens, Add to Cart is clicked and fails with a red error pill, then the dots swarm in a rage-click burst, the page blurs, a loading spinner appears and the session changes tab; every action appends a new row to the event log in sync with the narration 'or don't see ... automatically captured from the start. Even as your site evolves' (w157-w176).
annotation.build_rebuild: Render a static storefront mock inside a rounded player frame over an animated gradient, drive a cluster of 6-10 coloured dots along a scripted click path, and on each click append a row (icon + verb + grey value chip) to an absolutely positioned event-log card with a short slide-up, ending with a rage-click dot burst, blur-out and spinner.

annotation.focal_element: A full-frame field of thousands of overlapping coloured dots (the brand's four dot colours) representing all captured user data.
annotation.transition_other: Perspective zoom-through: the replay frame tilts in 3D, fills with tiny dots, and the camera pushes into it until the dots fill the frame.
annotation.what_happens: The UI frame swings into perspective and is flooded with confetti-like dots, then the camera flies into it so the whole screen becomes a dense, gently jittering dot field, visualising 'all the historical data' (w177-w189).
annotation.build_rebuild: Tilt the previous player frame with a CSS 3D rotateY, spawn a few thousand small circles in four brand colours inside it, then scale the frame past full-screen so the circles grow into a full-bleed dot field with slight per-dot noise motion.

annotation.focal_element: The dot field sorting itself into four horizontal colour bands, each labelled with a sentiment and dotted with small emoji-like faces.
annotation.transition_other: Continuous particle motion from the previous shot (no visible cut); the mixed dots begin streaming apart.
annotation.typography: Rounded, bold sans in sentence case, white fill with a soft dark drop shadow, centred over each band; labels reveal letter by letter (partial 'g gem' and 'Trepida.i' visible mid-reveal).
annotation.what_happens: The random dot field streams leftward and separates by colour into four stacked rivers (purple, green, orange, red); a few dots in each band morph into small character faces with matching moods, and the labels Delight, Engagement, Trepidation and Rage type on in sequence as the VO says 'you needed to ask. Plus, with full stories investments' (w190-w198).
annotation.build_rebuild: Run a particle simulation where each dot has a colour-based target y-band and lerps toward it with flow to the left, then fade in 2-3 face sprites per band and reveal the four band labels with a per-character stagger of about 40 ms, top to bottom.

annotation.focal_element: The orange (trepidation) dot stream flowing through a simplified journey/funnel map card, lighting up nodes until it lands on a 'Dead Click Add to Cart' node where a red flame-like rage character appears.
annotation.typography: Node cards use a small regular sans for the event-type label over a bold sentence-case title and small grey metric line; each activated card gains a multicolour gradient top bar. Metric lines on the Athena 1 and Dead Click cards are too small to read reliably.
annotation.what_happens: The orange band peels away from the others and streams right as the scene pushes to a peach background with a rounded app frame containing a journey map of skeleton cards joined by curved connectors; the orange particles travel node to node, each card resolving from grey placeholder bars into real content as they pass (White Sneakers, Athena 1, then a third-column node becoming 'Dead Click Add to Cart'), a red rage character pops up on that node, and the particle cluster drifts off as the frame slides away, under 'machine learning and AI, that data is automatically collected, translated, and ready to activate in real time. And by integrating' (w199-w219).
annotation.build_rebuild: Draw a 3-column node graph with SVG bezier connectors inside a rounded card, move a cluster of ~80 orange circles along the connector paths with a motion-path tween, and when the cluster reaches each node swap its skeleton bars for title text and a gradient top bar, finishing with a red character sprite popping in on the final node.

annotation.focal_element: A swarm of coloured dots that sweeps left-to-right across a centred two/three-word outcome headline, inking it from grey to the scene colour
annotation.typography: Geometric sans, bold/semibold, title case, normal tracking; text starts in a muted grey and is recoloured to a saturated tint matching the dot swarm as the swarm passes; motion-blurred on exit
annotation.what_happens: Four ~2 s outcome cards in sequence, each on its own pastel full-frame background (peach, pink, lavender, mint): a particle swarm enters from the left, travels across the grey headline recolouring it letter by letter, exits right while the headline motion-blurs, and the next coloured background pushes in from the left; VO over w220-w243 (integrating the tech stack ... win loyal customers for life).
annotation.build_rebuild: For each of four outcome labels, render a centred grey bold headline on a pastel full-bleed background, animate a ~150-dot particle cluster along x from off-left to off-right over ~1.5 s while a left-to-right clip mask reveals a coloured copy of the text under the cluster, then push in the next coloured background from the left.

annotation.focal_element: Simplified recreated product cards (text highlights, conversion map, revenue/conversion metric cards, a comment-to-Slack thread) floating over soft blurred colour blobs
on_screen_text: You have the details needed to
@techsupport Looks like there's a dead click here. Can you take a look?
annotation.typography: Geometric sans throughout; the VO-caption pills are medium weight, sentence case, black on white in a thin rounded outline; UI cards use small regular labels with bold large numerals for metrics; chat text is small regular sentence case
annotation.what_happens: The multicoloured dot swarm (all four previous colours merged) drifts past an outlined caption pill whose text resolves from blur ('With better behavioral data', then 'You have the details needed to'), the swarm funnels into a rounded empty card that blooms into a cluster of UI cards (text highlights, Force Restart session note, product conversion map) over an orange/pink glow; this swaps to a metric dashboard (Lost Revenue bars, Lost Conversions, Conversion Impact, Affected Users) whose numbers count and charts draw while a green blob mascot looks on; finally an empty card becomes a comment box where '@techsupport ... dead click' is typed, sent to Slack, and a reply 'Fixed it!' with emoji reactions appears. VO w244-w274 (interpret nuance, sentiment signals, monitor KPIs, predict behavior, pinpoint issues, train AI models).
annotation.build_rebuild: Over a white canvas with two large blurred radial-gradient blobs that slowly orbit, stage three card clusters in sequence, each born from a single outlined empty card that scales up and splits into staggered child cards, with metric numerals counted up and bar/line charts drawn on, ending with a typed comment that morphs into a Slack-style message thread.
